symptom: The research-only shadow mapper collected source-shape errors, point-in-time unresolved reasons and reconciliation conflicts using Array.prototype.push. A synthetic no-op push can discard a bad race number or post-decision program-import warning and make conflicting mapped rows report PASS. A Node 22.16.0 source-equivalent sink probe reproduced erased denials and false PASS. No private rows or production system were used.
lesson: A mapper can silently convert missing or contradictory decision-time evidence into a positive reconciliation verdict when its diagnostics and conflicts are stored through mutable ambient array helpers. Downstream record validation does not necessarily cover source-only provenance or chronology fields.
guardrail: Collect source validation errors, PIT unresolved reasons, warnings, rejected rows and reconciliation conflicts with own array data properties via Object.defineProperty. Regression-test malformed source identity, post-decision program visibility and conflicting identity under a reversible no-op Array.prototype.push, while checking valid digest parity. No evidence authentication, production apply or scoring authority.
